description: Pavement Condition Measures - PMF 2025 is a dataset listed in Hawaii Department of Transportation open data portal (highways.hidot.hawaii.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Hawaii Department of Transportation. This dataset provides a breakdown of pavement conditions for roads within the HDOT Highways system. The dataset breaks pavement condition down by 'Good', 'Fair', or 'Poor'. This information is updated on a yearly basis. Coverage: Hawaii. The portal files it under the category Pavement. The table has 5 columns. The portal shows 2025-11-18 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-highways-hidot-hawaii-gov-portal.
